transcript: Took my Concerta 36mg at 8am with breakfast. It kicked in after about 45 minutes and I was firing on all cylinders until lunch. Crashed hard around 3pm, dry mouth all afternoon. Still managed to finish the report, proud of that.
Honestly today my body just would not get going, like wading through wet sand from the moment I woke up. Could not get off the couch until noon.
I went to the store and bought milk. The meeting is at three tomorrow. Nothing much happened today.
The fridge was empty so I ordered groceries. My gym bag felt heavy. I've seen my therapist this morning and we talked about raw vegetables.
I was feeling really anxious on Monday. Today I'm actually calm and got my inbox to zero.
Slept maybe 5 hours, tossed and turned all night. Skipped my Vyvanse because my heart was racing yesterday. Felt foggy and irritable the whole morning.
I'm panicking about the deadline and I keep avoiding the email thread. Spent the evening doomscrolling instead.
Folded the laundry, did the dishes, then went for a long walk in the park to clear my head. Read a few chapters before bed.
Tomei o Concerta de 36mg às 8 da manhã. Dormi só 5 horas e passei o dia todo ansioso, sem conseguir começar nada. Boca seca a tarde inteira.
Hoy no tomé el Vyvanse y estuve agotado toda la tarde, sin poder concentrarme. Cené temprano y caminé un rato por el parque.
Today was great, honestly one of the best days in ages. I felt happy and light, like everything was clicking into place.
I'm so overwhelmed right now, completely buried under deadlines and the to-do list just keeps growing. Feeling really stressed and on edge all day.
After I finally sent that email it was like a weight lifted off my shoulders, and I could breathe again. Spent the rest of the afternoon feeling settled.
Everything just felt grey and pointless today, like there was no colour in anything. I was sad for most of the morning and couldn't shake it.
Pretty meh day, just kind of numb and going through the motions. Didn't feel much of anything either way, totally indifferent.
I'm alright, not bad at all really. Got curious about a new podcast and ended up taking notes, which was kind of nice.
Renewed the car insurance, called the dentist to reschedule, and dropped a parcel at the post office. Nothing else on the calendar this week.
I lost my keys again so I spent ten minutes retracing my steps before they turned up in my coat. Then I caught the later bus into town.
Started the morning with Ritalin 10mg and I take my Wellbutrin with it now. The combo seems smoother, less of a hard comedown in the afternoon.
Completely forgot to take my Adderall this morning and only realised at lunch. The whole day was a write-off, couldn't focus on a single thing.
The psychiatrist switched me off Strattera and onto Elvanse starting today. First dose of the Elvanse went down fine, no obvious side effects yet.
I bumped my Conserta up to 54 milligrams this week on the doctor's advice. Appetite has tanked though, barely touched lunch.
The Vyvanse has me wired and jittery, hands literally shaking by mid-afternoon, and I could not fall asleep until 2am with my heart pounding.
Got about 7 hours last night and woke up before the alarm feeling rested. Made a proper breakfast instead of skipping it for once.
Barely slept, maybe three hours total because the baby was up all night. I'm completely exhausted and running on fumes.
Slept a solid nine hours and yet I still feel worn out, which makes no sense. Dragged myself through the morning.
Worked a brutal 12 hours straight at the office, back to back meetings with no break. Light dinner and straight to bed, didn't even check my phone.
I knew exactly what I needed to do but I just could not start any of it, sat staring at the screen for an hour. My head was all over the place and I felt restless and useless.
Absolutely nailed the presentation today, the client signed off on the spot. Felt accomplished and proud walking out of that room.
The inbox was a mountain and I felt completely overwhelmed at first, but once I got into the zone I powered through it. Ended up feeling really motivated.
Nothing dramatic, but I cleared the small admin tasks I'd been putting off for weeks and felt quietly content about it. Grateful for a calm evening.
Light rain most of the morning then it cleared up by lunchtime. The bins go out tonight and the recycling is on Thursday this week.
Spent forty quid on a new phone charger and a pack of batteries at the shop. The bus was a couple of minutes late but otherwise an uneventful trip.
Forecast says scattered showers tomorrow afternoon. The plumber is booked for nine, and the parcel is meant to arrive sometime between noon and four.
Que dia maravilhoso, me senti ótimo do começo ao fim. Tomei meu Ritalina de manhã e consegui terminar tudo no trabalho, muito orgulhoso.
Dormi apenas 4 horas e acordei exausto. Mesmo assim lavei a louça e fiz a faxina da casa toda antes do almoço.
Esqueci de tomar o Adderall hoje e fiquei com uma dor de cabeça horrível a tarde inteira, sem conseguir me concentrar.
Hoy me sentí muy triste y ansioso todo el día, no podía dejar de preocuparme. Tomé mi Concerta de 36 miligramos pero no ayudó mucho.
Dormí ocho horas y me desperté con mucha energía. Salí a correr por el parque y me sentí genial, muy contento el resto del día.
El Elvanse me deja la boca muy seca y sin apetito, casi no almorcé. Por la noche me costó muchísimo dormir.
